purpose: Teach: 駆ら/向かわ/住環境/引き取っ/鉄筋コンクリート/取り外し/同乗/拝聴

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、探究心に駆られた研究姿勢を保て
lines.en: Ren — hold on to that research attitude of yours, the one driven by real curiosity.
lines.style: Name first, low and level. A firm mentor's charge, unhurried, each word placed with intent.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外学会に向かわせて頂きます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'd be honored to go to the overseas conference.
lines.style: Quick eager affirmation, slightly over-formal phrasing, nerves audible under the earnestness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究員の住環境改善に協力しろ
lines.en: Ren, help improve the researchers' living conditions.
lines.style: Plain economical directive, dry tone, softened only by the steady confidence he places in the young man.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩の研究テーマを引き取って継承します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll take over my senior's research topic and carry it forward.
lines.style: Solemn commitment, careful over-precise diction, a small swell of pride on carrying it forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究施設の鉄筋コンクリート構造を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, check the reinforced concrete structure of the research facility.
lines.style: Brisk technical order, a deliberate slowing over the specification, then a clipped full stop.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古い装置の取り外し計画を立てます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll draw up a plan for removing the old equipment.
lines.style: Prompt, tidy response, the faint relief of a task he actually knows how to do.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、調査出張で先生に同乗、つまり同乗させて頂け
lines.en: Ren, on the survey trip, ride along with the professor — that is, ask properly if you may ride along.
lines.style: Instruction with a correcting beat mid-line, patient but pointed, teaching etiquette as much as logistics.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で著名研究者のご講演を拝聴します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll be sure to attend the distinguished researchers' lectures at the conference.
lines.style: Earnest closing pledge, sitting up straight in the voice, bright determination breaking through the formality.
